lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Meridian wants to endow us. Buildings, a wall, a stipend, and a seat on our own board for one of theirs. I have been staring at it for two days.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: We took their money. There will be a wall by spring and a name on the gate that is not ours. I will not pretend that costs nothing.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: We refused. We will be cold for twenty years and we will own every cold inch of it.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: If you have an opinion, say it. I would rather be argued with than agreed with.
